newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI jumps seven pct by noon.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI jumps seven pct by noon.

text.p: Shares of Industrial Credit & Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) surged seven percent on Friday, dealers said.
This takes the total rise to 13 percent since Monday, when the announced a 62 percent jump in net profit for the year ended March 31, 1997, dealers said.
The share was up 4.50 rupees, or 7.1 percent, at 67.50 on the Bombay Stock Exchange, off the day's high of 69.25.
The term lender announced a net profit of 7.7 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) after adjustment for previous year balances against last year's 4.74 billion rupees.
More than 241,000 shares were traded at the Bombay exchange by noon on Friday.
The results are post-merger figures. ICICI announced a merger with SCICI in January, but the merger took effect from April 1, 1996.
High capital gains and low tax provisions helped ICICI post a higher than expected net profit, analysts said.
